metadata.source_note: Complete numbered DA-KG Stand 2025 sections O, A, V, R and S on PDF pages 13–159, using the original BZSt-authored PDF retained by Tacheles. Mirror bytes exactly match the existing oracles de-subject-003 receipt; no government-host capture of these historical bytes is claimed. The live legacy official endpoint now serves Stand 2026. All 420 source labels match the independently retained official table-of-contents census. Native heading continuation uses exact observed source title lines to avoid swallowing operative paragraphs. Structural headings and repealed-heading rows may have empty bodies. Source page numbers and intervening chapter headings remain visible; preface, contents pages and the appendix are retained in the source PDF but not normalized in this scope. Capture date is not commencement or issuance. The separate A19.2 atomic capture remains available; numbered-sections is a distinct navigation namespace and must not cause duplicate executable encodings of the same legal rule.
